```{r Standard Setup}
# Configure directories, load libraries and base functions
source(paste0(here::here(), "/0-config.R"))

directory = paste0(here(), "/3-figures/")

##### FIX THIS LATER ##### 
sample_file_path <- "/Users/bfu/Dropbox/Group_projects/Capsule-Gen2-LONGIT-Wk/LONGIT-Weeklong_SampleSheet_FINAL.xlsx"

kits <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 1)
samples <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 2)
##### FIX THIS LATER ##### 

output <- setup_tables(paste0(here(), "/1-data/DADA2-Weeklong/"), '/1-data/Capscan-weeklong-sample-info.xlsx')
ps <- output$ps # phyloseq object
taxa_order <- output$taxa_order # ASV plot order
samdf <- output$samdf # sample information
samdf$Sample <- rownames(samdf)

total_reads <- as.data.frame(sample_sums(ps)) # get total number of reads
colnames(total_reads) <- "total_reads"
total_reads$Sample <- rownames(total_reads)

# Add read counts and sample info
samdf <- samdf %>%
  left_join(total_reads, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(total_reads = ifelse(is.na(total_reads), 0, total_reads)) %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "Sample_ID")

# update samdf of phyloseq
rownames(samdf) <- sub('sample_', '', samdf$Sample) # change row names to be the sequencing name, remove "sample_"
samdf <- samdf %>%
  select(-Sample) 
sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(samdf)

#######################################
# Variables to change
#######################################

set_ordered_factors <- function(df2plot) {
  # Set default ordered factors in dataframe
  df2plot <- df2plot %>%
      mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c("NA", "Saliva", "R1", "R2", "R3", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin = factor(Sample_origin, levels = c("Capscan0", "Capscan1", "Capscan2", "Capscan3", "Capscan3E", "Capscan4", "Capscan4E", "Capscan5", "Capscan5E", "Capscan6", "Capscan6E", "Capscan7", "Capscan8", "CapscanExtra1", "CapscanExtra2", "CapscanExtra3", "ExtraSaliva", "Saliva0", "Saliva1", "Saliva2", "Saliva3", "Saliva3E", "Saliva4", "Saliva4E", "Saliva5", "Saliva5E", "Saliva6", "Saliva6E", "Saliva7", "Saliva8", "Stool0", "Stool1", "Stool2", "Stool3", "Stool3E", "Stool4", "Stool5", "Stool5E", "Stool6", "Stool6E", "Stool7", "Stool8", "StoolExtra1", "StoolExtra2", "StoolNoCapscan"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Sample_origin2 = factor(Sample_origin2, levels = c("Cap0", "Cap1", "Cap2", "Cap3", "CapE1", "Cap4", "Cap5", "CapE2", "Cap6", "Cap7", "Cap8", "CapEx1", "CapEx2", "CapEx3", "SalivaX", "Saliva0", "Saliva1", "Saliva2", "Saliva3", "Saliva3E", "Saliva4", "Saliva4E", "Saliva5", "Saliva5E", "Saliva6", "Saliva6E", "Saliva7", "Saliva8", "Stool0", "Stool1", "Stool2", "Stool3", "Stool3E", "Stool4", "Stool5", "Stool5E", "Stool6", "Stool6E", "Stool7", "Stool8", "StoolExtra1", "StoolExtra2", "StoolNoCapscan"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(Kit_set = factor(Kit_set, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3E", "3", "4E", "4", "5E", "5", "6E", "6", "7", "8", "Extra")))
  df2plot$total_reads <- factor(df2plot$total_reads)
  return(df2plot)
}

saliva_colors <- c("Saliva0" = "#A31301FF", "Saliva1" = "#D23105FF", "Saliva2" = "#F05B12FF", "Saliva3E" = "#FE932AFF", "Saliva3" = "#F6C33AFF", "Saliva4E" = "#D3E835FF", "Saliva4" = "#A2FC3CFF", "Saliva5E" = "#5EFC6EFF", "Saliva5" = "#20EAABFF", "Saliva6E" = "#1FC9DDFF", "Saliva6" = "#3E9BFEFF", "Saliva7" = "#466BE3FF",   "Saliva8" = "#3E378FFF")

stool_colors <- c("Stool0" = "#A31301FF", "Stool1" = "#D23105FF", "Stool2" = "#F05B12FF", "Stool3E" = "#FE932AFF", "Stool3" = "#F6C33AFF", "Stool4E" = "#D3E835FF", "Stool4" = "#A2FC3CFF", "Stool5E" = "#5EFC6EFF", "Stool5" = "#20EAABFF", "Stool6E" = "#1FC9DDFF", "Stool6" = "#3E9BFEFF", "Stool7" = "#466BE3FF",   "Stool8" = "#3E378FFF")

kit_colors <- c("0" = "#A31301FF", "1" = "#D23105FF", "2" = "#F05B12FF", "3E" = "#FE932AFF", "3" = "#F6C33AFF", "4E" = "#D3E835FF", "4" = "#A2FC3CFF", "5E" = "#5EFC6EFF", "5" = "#20EAABFF", "6E" = "#1FC9DDFF", "6" = "#3E9BFEFF", "7" = "#466BE3FF",   "8" = "#3E378FFF", Extra = "#CCCCCC")
```

```{r Sequencer stats}
num_zeros <- sum(samdf$total_reads == 0)
num_samples <- sum(samdf$total_reads >= 0)

g <- ggplot(samdf, aes(x = log10(total_reads), fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("log10(reads)", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  labs(x = "log10(reads)", y = "Counts", subtitle = paste0(num_zeros, " of ", num_samples, " samples have 0 reads.")) + 
  ggtitle("Read distribution") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Weeklong-Sequencer/Read-counts-region.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
```

#######################################
# Composition 0 read cutoff, highlight <10k reads

```{r Composition - by sample_origin}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Region == "Saliva")

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
  
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
  
family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
  
    g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid), aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
         geom_bar(aes(x = total_reads), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
         scale_x_discrete(labels = red_if_small_discrete) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         facet_nested(cols = vars(Collection_date, Collection_time, Sample_origin2), scales = "free", space = "free") +
         theme_custom_comp() +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
        
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Saliva-collection/Composition-saliva-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.5*length(unique(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>% pull(No))) + 1, height = 4)
}

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
     geom_bar(aes(x = 1), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
     scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
     theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = FALSE)) + # Legend columns, fill legend items by column
     labs(fill = "Family") + # Change legend label
     theme_custom_text()

legend <- get_legend(g)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Saliva-collection/Composition-saliva-legend.pdf"), plot = legend, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 12)
```

```{r Composition - All by sample_origin - order by kit set}

ps2plot <- ps

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
  
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renormalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
  
family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {

    g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin), aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
         geom_bar(aes(x = interaction(total_reads, Region, Kit_set)), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
         scale_x_discrete(labels = red_if_small_discrete_reads_only) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         facet_wrap(vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free") +
         theme_custom_comp() +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
               axis.text.y = element_blank())
        
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Composition-all-", sample_origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 20, height = 12)
}
```

```{r Composition - capscan heirarchical clustering}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin3 == "Capscan"
                                 & total_reads > 10000)

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize

df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors



####

for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {

    dist_mat <- phyloseq::distance(ps2plot, method = d_metric)
    hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "average")
    sample_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
    
    df2plot$Sample <- factor(df2plot$Sample, levels = sample_order)
      
    family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors
    
    g_comp <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) +
      geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, width = 1) +
      #scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )
    
    # Create annotation data for each sample
    annotation_data <- df2plot %>%
      select(Sample, Subject_ID, Region, Prediction) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(Subject_ID, Region, Prediction), 
                   names_to = "Annotation", 
                   values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Annotation = factor(Annotation, levels = c("Subject_ID", "Region", "Prediction")))
    
    family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors
    
    g_comp <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) +
      geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, width = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )
    
    colors_prediction = c("SI_light" = "#F8766D", "SI" = "#A3A500", "SI_dark" = "#00BF7D", "AC" = "#00B0F6", "NA" = "#E76BF3")
    colors_subject <- setNames(hue_pal()(20), unique(samdf$Subject_ID))
    
    # Create annotation plot
    g_annot <- ggplot(annotation_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Annotation, fill = Value)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors_subject, colors_origin, colors_prediction)) +  # Combine your color palettes
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "null"
      )
    
    g_combined <- g_comp / g_annot + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.5))
    
    g_combined
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-composition-0p01/Composition-all-Capscan-clustered-", d_metric, ".pdf"), plot = g_combined, device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
}
```

```{r Alpha diversity}

alpha_df <- estimate_richness(ps,
                              measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson"))
rownames(alpha_df) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(alpha_df))
alpha_df$sample <- substr(rownames(alpha_df), 2, nchar(rownames(alpha_df)))

df2plot <- samdf %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(alpha_df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(Shannon = replace_na(Shannon, 0)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") 

df2plot <- df2plot %>% filter(total_reads > 10000)

df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot)

shannon_summary <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_shannon = sd(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_shannon = min(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_shannon = max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    range = paste0(round(min(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " - ", 
                   round(max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shannon_means <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
  summarise(mean_shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Shannon, fill = Region)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(data = shannon_means, aes(xintercept = mean_shannon), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = shannon_means, 
            aes(x = mean_shannon, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Avg: %.2f", mean_shannon)),
            vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "red", size = 2,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  scale_x_continuous("Shannon diversity", limits = c(0, NA), breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Sample_origin3)) +
  labs(x = "Shannon diversity", y = "Counts") +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
```

```{r PCoA - by sample origin}

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa

for (region in c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool")) {
    
    ps2ordinate <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin3 == region 
                                         & total_reads > 10000) # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
    otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)
    
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
    otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples
    
    retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)
    
    # Subset all components accordingly
    ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
                               sample_data(ps),
                               tax_table(ps)[retained_otus, ],
                               phy_tree(ps))
    
    ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)
    
    for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
    
      pcoa_weighted <- ordinate(ps_clean, method = "MDS", distance = d_metric)
      ordination_data <- merge(pcoa_weighted$vectors, samdf, by = "row.names")
      var_exp <- get_evals(pcoa_weighted)$variance_exp # variances
  
      x_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.1)
      y_range <- range(ordination_data$Axis.2)
      aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range)
      
      ordination_data <- set_ordered_factors(ordination_data) # set ordered factors
      
      lines_df <- ordination_data %>%
        filter(Region %in% region_order) %>%
        mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = region_order)) %>%
        arrange(Sample_ID, Region)  # Ensures correct order within Kit_ID

        colors2plot <- saliva_colors
```

```{r Distances between paired capscan and stool}

ps_filtered <- ps %>%
  subset_samples(total_reads > 10000
                 & Sample_origin3 %in% c("Capscan", "Stool"))

paired_distances <- list()

for (d_metric in c("wunifrac", "unifrac", "bray", "canberra", "binary")) {
  
  # Calculate distance matrix
  dist_mat <- distance(ps_filtered, method = d_metric)
  dist_df <- as.matrix(dist_mat)
  
  # Get sample metadata
  sample_info <- sample_data(ps_filtered) %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample")
  
  # Find paired samples (same Kit_ID, different Sample_origin3)
  capscan_samples <- sample_info %>% filter(Sample_origin3 == "Capscan")
  stool_samples <- sample_info %>% filter(Sample_origin3 == "Stool")
  
  # Match by Kit_ID
  paired_results <- capscan_samples %>%
    inner_join(stool_samples, by = "Kit_ID", suffix = c("_Capscan", "_Stool")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      distance = dist_df[Sample_Capscan, Sample_Stool],
      metric = d_metric
    ) %>%
    select(Kit_ID, Subject_ID_Capscan, Sample_Capscan, Region_Capscan, Prediction_Capscan, Sample_Stool, distance, metric, )
  
  paired_distances[[d_metric]] <- paired_results
}

# Combine all results
all_paired_distances <- bind_rows(paired_distances)
all_paired_distances <- all_paired_distances %>%
  mutate(Prediction_Capscan = factor(Prediction_Capscan, levels = c("SI_light", "SI", "SI_dark", "AC", "NA")))

g <- ggplot(all_paired_distances, aes(x = Prediction_Capscan, y = distance, fill = Prediction_Capscan)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(metric)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 1, size = 0.1) +
    labs(title = "Capscan vs Stool Distances by Metric",
         x = "Distance Metric",
         y = "Distance") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-PCoA/Distances-betw-cap-stool-prediction.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 5)

g <- ggplot(all_paired_distances, aes(x = Region_Capscan, y = distance, fill = Region_Capscan)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(metric)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 1, size = 0.1) +
    labs(title = "Capscan vs Stool Distances by Metric",
```

```{r Total ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
nonzero_per_sample <- NULL

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {

  ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(total_reads > 10000)
  
  taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff)
      
  ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>% # renormalize
        transform_sample_counts(function(x) {
          x[x < cutoff] <- 0
          x/sum(x)  # renormalize again so remaining abundances sum to 1
        })
  
    temp_counts <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
      filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
      group_by(Sample) %>%
      summarise(!!gsub("\\.", "p", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%")) := n())
  
  # Join to existing dataframe
  if (is.null(nonzero_per_sample)) {
    nonzero_per_sample <- temp_counts
  } else {
    nonzero_per_sample <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
      left_join(temp_counts, by = "Sample")
  }
}

nonzero_lf <- nonzero_per_sample %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, 
               names_to = "cutoff", 
               values_to = "num_ASVs") %>% 
  left_join(samdf %>% rownames_to_column("Sample"), by = "Sample")

    min_ASVs = min(num_ASVs, na.rm = TRUE),
```

#######################################
# Shared ASVs
#######################################

```{r Shared number of ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
results_list <- list()

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {
  
  # Filter and transform phyloseq object
  ps2plot <- ps %>%
    subset_samples(total_reads > 10000) %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>%
    filter_taxa(function(x) any(x > cutoff), TRUE)
  
  # Get presence/absence of ASVs per sample
  df <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
    filter(Abundance > cutoff) %>%
    select(OTU, Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Get ASVs per individual sample
  asv_by_sample <- df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    summarise(ASVs = list(unique(OTU)), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Compare samples between different subject pairs, within same sample type
  shared_asvs <- asv_by_sample %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
    do({
      current_data <- .
      
      # Get all pairs of subjects (including both directions)
      subject_pairs <- expand.grid(
        idx1 = seq_len(nrow(current_data)),
        idx2 = seq_len(nrow(current_data)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        filter(current_data$Subject_ID[idx1] != current_data$Subject_ID[idx2])  # Only different subjects
      
      subject_pairs %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(
          Subject1 = current_data$Subject_ID[idx1],
          Subject2 = current_data$Subject_ID[idx2],
          Sample1 = current_data$Sample[idx1],
          Sample2 = current_data$Sample[idx2],
          n_shared = length(intersect(
            current_data$ASVs[[idx1]], 
            current_data$ASVs[[idx2]]
          )),
          n_sample1 = length(current_data$ASVs[[idx1]]),
          n_sample2 = length(current_data$ASVs[[idx2]])
        ) %>%
        select(-idx1, -idx2)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cutoff = gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%"))))
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- shared_asvs
}

# Combine all results
all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Calculate average shared ASVs per subject pair
summary_by_subject_pair <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Subject1, Subject2, Sample_origin3, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared = mean(n_shared),
    sd_shared = sd(n_shared),
    n_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall summary by sample type and cutoff
overall_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared = mean(n_shared),
    median_shared = median(n_shared),
    sd_shared = sd(n_shared),
    n_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_by_subject_pair <- summary_by_subject_pair %>%
  mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE))
```

```{r Shared abundance of ASVs}

cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.001, 0.0001)
results_list <- list()

for (cutoff in cutoffs) {
  
  # Filter and transform phyloseq object
  ps2plot <- ps %>%
    subset_samples(total_reads > 10000) %>%
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))
  
  # Get abundance data
  df <- psmelt(ps2plot) %>%
    select(OTU, Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3, Abundance)
  
  # Identify ASVs present above cutoff per sample
  asvs_above_cutoff <- df %>%
    filter(Abundance > cutoff) %>%
    select(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3, OTU) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Get samples grouped by subject and sample type
  samples_by_subject <- df %>%
    select(Sample, Subject_ID, Sample_origin3) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # For each subject pair within same sample type
  shared_abundance <- samples_by_subject %>%
    group_by(Sample_origin3) %>%
    do({
      current_samples <- .
      
      # Get all pairs of subjects
      subject_pairs <- expand.grid(
        Subject1 = unique(current_samples$Subject_ID),
        Subject2 = unique(current_samples$Subject_ID),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        filter(Subject1 != Subject2)
      
      subject_pairs %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        do({
          s1 <- .$Subject1
          s2 <- .$Subject2
          samp_origin <- current_samples$Sample_origin3[1]
          
          # Get samples for each subject
          samples_s1 <- current_samples %>% filter(Subject_ID == s1) %>% pull(Sample)
          samples_s2 <- current_samples %>% filter(Subject_ID == s2) %>% pull(Sample)
          
          # Get ASVs present above cutoff in Subject1
          asvs_s1 <- asvs_above_cutoff %>%
            filter(Sample %in% samples_s1, Sample_origin3 == samp_origin) %>%
            pull(OTU) %>%
            unique()
          
          # Calculate total abundance of those ASVs in Subject2 samples
          # (regardless of whether they're above cutoff in Subject2)
          abundance_in_s2 <- df %>%
            filter(Sample %in% samples_s2, 
                   Sample_origin3 == samp_origin,
                   OTU %in% asvs_s1) %>%
            group_by(Sample) %>%
            summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
          
          # Calculate average abundance across Subject2 samples
          avg_abundance <- ifelse(nrow(abundance_in_s2) > 0, 
                                  mean(abundance_in_s2$total_abundance), 
                                  0)
          
          data.frame(
            Subject1 = s1,
            Subject2 = s2,
            Sample_origin3 = samp_origin,
            n_asvs_subject1 = length(asvs_s1),
            avg_abundance_in_subject2 = avg_abundance,
            n_samples_subject2 = length(samples_s2)
          )
        }) %>%
        ungroup()
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cutoff = gsub("\\.", "p", gsub("%", "", paste0(cutoff * 100, "%"))))
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- shared_abundance
}

# Combine all results
all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(Sample_origin3 = factor(Sample_origin3, levels = c("Saliva", "Capscan", "Stool"), ordered = TRUE))

g <- ggplot(all_results, aes(x = Subject1, y = Subject2, fill = 100*avg_abundance_in_subject2)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      facet_grid(Sample_origin3 ~ cutoff) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(0, 100)) +
      labs(title = "Percent shared ASVs between all subject pairs",
           fill = "% Shared\nASVs",
           x = "ASVs in Subject 1 at X cutoff",
           y = "% abundance of ASVs in Subject 2") +
      coord_fixed() +  # Makes tiles square
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),  # Black outline
            legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + # Black ticks
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/Abundance/All-subjects.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 9)

for (region in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
```

```{r Most prevalent ASVs 0p01}

# Get ASVs detectable at >1% for each subject and sample type
detectable_asvs <- ps %>%
  subset_samples(total_reads > 10000) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) %>%  # Convert to relative abundance
  psmelt() %>%
  filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT) %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Sample_origin3, Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples_detected = n(),
    Taxon = first(Taxon),  # Get taxonomy info
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate prevalence (number of subjects with each ASV)
asv_prevalence <- detectable_asvs %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin3, Feature, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subjects = n_distinct(Subject_ID),
    subjects_list = paste(sort(unique(Subject_ID)), collapse = ", "),
    mean_samples_detected = mean(n_samples_detected),
    total_samples = sum(n_samples_detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample_origin3, desc(n_subjects), desc(mean_samples_detected))

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {

    features_to_keep <- asv_prevalence %>%
      filter(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin, n_subjects >= 2) %>%
      pull(Feature)
    
   temp_complete <- detectable_asvs %>% 
    filter(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin,
           Feature %in% features_to_keep) %>%
    complete(Subject_ID, nesting(Feature, Taxon), fill = list(n_samples_detected = 0)) %>%
    left_join(
      asv_prevalence %>% 
        filter(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin) %>%
        select(Feature, Taxon, n_subjects) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = c("Feature", "Taxon")
    )

  mat <- temp_complete %>%
      mutate(feature_taxon = interaction(Feature, Taxon)) %>%
      select(Subject_ID, feature_taxon, n_samples_detected) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Subject_ID, values_from = n_samples_detected, values_fill = 0) %>%
      column_to_rownames("feature_taxon") %>%
      as.matrix()
  
  # Create pheatmap
    g <- pheatmap(mat,
         color = c("black", colorRampPalette(c("white", "blue"))(99)),
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_row = 6,
         fontsize_col = 6,
         border_color = "black",
         angle_col = 0,
         breaks = c(0, seq(0.01, max(mat), length.out = 99)))

  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Shared-ASVs/All-subjects-", sample_origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 8, height = 0.1 * n_distinct(temp_complete$Feature) + 2)
}
```

```{r Calculate fluctuation variance}
all_slopes <- data.frame()
```

```{r Co-correlated ASVs - individual}

fdr_matrix <- function(pmat) {
  p <- pmat[upper.tri(pmat)]
  padj <- p.adjust(p, "fdr")
  
  out <- matrix(NA, nrow(pmat), ncol(pmat))
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  out <- t(out)
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  
  rownames(out) <- rownames(pmat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(pmat)
  diag(out) <- NA
  out
}

cor_long <- data_frame()

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {

  for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Subject_ID == sid 
                                     & Sample_origin3 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    # Skip if not enough samples
    if (nsamples(ps2plot) <= 4) {
      message("Skipping ", sid, " - ", sample_origin, ": only ", nsamples(ps2plot), " samples")
      next
    }
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    otu <- as(otu_table(ps2plot), "matrix")
    otu_clr <- clr(otu + 1e-7)
    res <- rcorr(otu_clr)
    
    p_adj_mat <- fdr_matrix(res$P)
    
    cor_mat <- res$r
    
    idx <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate number of real observations (not 1e-7 pseudocounts)
    n_real_obs <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Count samples where both features are > 1e-7 (i.e., actually detected)
      sum(otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7)
    })

    temp <- data.frame(
      feature1 = rownames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]],
      feature2 = colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]],
      r        = cor_mat[idx],
      fdr_p    = p_adj_mat[idx],
      n_obs    = n_real_obs,
      Subject_ID = sid,
      Sample_origin = sample_origin
    )
    
    cor_long <- rbind(cor_long, temp)
  }
}

        scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
        scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
        scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
              linewidth = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE, 
              aes(x = Feature1_abund, y = Feature2_abund)) +  # Override grouping
        scale_fill_manual(values = kit_colors) +
        force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                         cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                         TRUE) +
        labs( title = paste0(otu_map$Taxon[otu_map$Feature == f1], " vs ", otu_map$Taxon[otu_map$Feature == f2], "\n", sid, " ", sample_origin, " r: ", round(r, 3), " p-val: ", round(p_val, 3)), x = paste0(f1), y = paste0(f2)) +
        theme_custom_text() +
        theme(legend.position = "null")
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-ASV-Fluctuation-0p01/", sid, "/", sample_origin, "-correlations/", sid, "-", sample_origin, "-", f1, "-", f2, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 3)
}
```

```{r Co-correlated ASVs - across all subjects}

fdr_matrix <- function(pmat) {
  p <- pmat[upper.tri(pmat)]
  padj <- p.adjust(p, "fdr")
  
  out <- matrix(NA, nrow(pmat), ncol(pmat))
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  out <- t(out)
  out[upper.tri(out)] <- padj
  
  rownames(out) <- rownames(pmat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(pmat)
  diag(out) <- NA
  out
}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(total_reads > 10000)

stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
 
ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)

df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

otu_map <- unique(df2plot %>% select(Feature, OTU, Taxon))

cor_long <- data_frame()

for (sample_origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin3)) {
    
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_origin3 == sample_origin
                                     & total_reads > 10000)
    
    # Skip if not enough samples
    if (nsamples(ps2plot) <= 4) {
      message("Skipping ", sid, " - ", sample_origin, ": only ", nsamples(ps2plot), " samples")
      next
    }
    
    stringent_taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
        filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT)
    
    ps2plot <- ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # normalize (NO PRUNING)
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(stringent_taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot)
    
    otu <- as(otu_table(ps2plot), "matrix")
    
    # Get sample metadata for subject tracking
    sample_meta <- sample_data(ps2plot) %>% 
      data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample")
    
    otu_clr <- clr(otu + 1e-7)
    res <- rcorr(otu_clr)
    
    p_adj_mat <- fdr_matrix(res$P)
    
    cor_mat <- res$r
    
    idx <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate number of real observations (not 1e-7 pseudocounts)
    n_real_obs <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Count samples where both features are > 1e-7 (i.e., actually detected)
      sum(otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7)
    })
    
    # Calculate number of subjects
    n_subjects <- apply(idx, 1, function(i) {
      f1 <- rownames(cor_mat)[i[1]]
      f2 <- colnames(cor_mat)[i[2]]
      # Get samples where both features detected
      samples_with_both <- rownames(otu)[otu[, f1] > 1e-7 & otu[, f2] > 1e-7]
      # Count unique subjects
      n_distinct(sample_meta$Subject_ID[sample_meta$Sample %in% samples_with_both])
    })

    temp <- data.frame(
      feature1 = rownames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]],
      feature2 = colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]],
      r        = cor_mat[idx],
      fdr_p    = p_adj_mat[idx],
      n_obs    = n_real_obs,
      n_subj   = n_subjects,
      Sample_origin = sample_origin
    )
    
    cor_long <- rbind(cor_long, temp)
}

cor_long_filter <- cor_long %>% filter(abs(r) > 0.75 & n_obs > 4 & n_subj > 5 & fdr_p < 0.05) 

summary_counts <- cor_long_filter %>%
  group_by(Sample_origin) %>%

    .groups = "drop"

    names_from = Feature,

  )
  
  g <- ggplot(temp_wide, aes(x = Feature1_abund, y = Feature2_abund, shape = Region)) +
        geom_point(aes(fill = Subject_ID), size = 2) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c("R1" = 21, "R2" = 22, "R3" = 23, "R4" = 24, "Saliva" = 21, "Stool" = 21)) +
        scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
        scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed",

              aes(x = Feature1_abund, y = Feature2_abund)) +  # Override grouping
        #scale_fill_manual(values = kit_colors) +
        force_panelsizes(rows =  unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                         cols = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "cm"), 
                         TRUE) +
        labs( title = paste0(otu_map$Taxon[otu_map$Feature == f1], " vs ", otu_map$Taxon[otu_map$Feature == f2], "\n", sample_origin, " r: ", round(r, 3), " p-val: ", round(p_val, 3)), x = paste0(f1), y = paste0(f2)) +
        theme_custom_text() +
        theme(legend.position = "null")
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-ASV-Fluctuation-0 p01/All/", sample_origin, "-correlations/All-", sample_origin, "-", f1, "-", f2, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 3)
```
